**Root cause:** The running `valkey-cart` process had its maxmemory lowered at runtime — at 04:13:40 UTC a one-off Job (`valkey-cart-init`, created 04:13:27, container `valkey-cli`, pod logs `OK\nOK\n`) issued `CONFIG SET maxmemory 1048576` (1 MiB) on the live server.
